items.question: Who do you work with?
items.answer: School leaders who are serious about strengthening the Foundation Years: owners, principals, academic leaders, coordinators and teachers. I also write for families and educators through Foundation Years First.

items.question: What does working with a school look like?
items.answer: We start with the questions your team is already facing, look at what children actually experience across the day, agree a change you can put into practice, and plan how to see what happens next.

items.question: What kind of support do you offer?
items.answer: Curriculum design, teacher development, school audits, leadership mentoring, classroom observation, assessment frameworks, documentation practices, inclusion support and school improvement planning, aligned with NEP 2020, ECCE policy and NCF-FS.

items.question: What is PlayXploration?
items.answer: PlayXploration is the initiative I founded to help schools reimagine play-based learning as one of the deepest ways children build school readiness. It makes visible executive function, emotional regulation, curiosity, persistence, collaboration, language and problem-solving.

items.question: What is Foundation Years First?
items.answer: It is an initiative of Educational Mentoring India, launched on 3 October 2026. It brings together child development, research, policy, pedagogy, family perspectives and classroom reality, with age guides and articles for families and educators.

items.question: Do you work outside India?
items.answer: Yes. I have worked in Early Childhood Education across India and the Gulf, and I have designed curricula for 10 national and 2 international organisations.

items.question: Is the advice on this site medical advice?
items.answer: No. The age guides and articles are about noticing and supporting everyday learning. If you are worried about a child's development, please speak to a paediatrician or another qualified specialist.

items.question: How do I get in touch?
items.answer: Use the contact form and tell me about your school or event, the age group and what you would like to work on.
